accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.summary: Permanently remove your Kinsroot account and personal profile.

Anonymized family membership and financial records remain for accounting; outstanding obligations are not cancelled. This cannot be undone. Sign in again first if your last sign-in was over 15 minutes ago.
